description: BM25-ranked search over content+title+tags in the active project's agent_memory. v2.3.0 NEW. Lexical-only (FTS5). Vector search is v2.4.0+. Use this tool instead of re-implementing FTS5 escape in client code.

agent_id.description: Optional. Scopes results to rows where agent_id == this value (Mem0 agent_id). v2.3.0.

kind.description: Optional. Filter to one operator-kind (note, observation, decision, ...).

memory_type.description: Optional. Mem0 three-class taxonomy filter. v2.3.0.

operator.description: Operator id (INV-1 audit + result attribution). NOT an ownership filter by default — recall searches the whole active project. Pass scope='operator' to narrow to this operator's rows. v2.21.0 (spec 1200 T2).

query.description: FTS5 search query. Alphanumeric + . - _ / + * only; AND/OR/NOT/NEAR rejected.

scope.description: Ownership axis. Default 'project' (all operators/sessions). 'operator' narrows to the operator's rows; 'agent' to agent_id's rows; 'session' to the active session. v2.21.0 (spec 1200 T2).

name: dark_memory_agent_memory_recall
